decisions.reason: A classic lever handle sits at the core of the firm's established know-how, and its in-house R&D lets it interpret early results and refine the product.
A lever handle family builds directly on the firm's design and fixing expertise and fits its push toward broader system families.
A handle design close to the existing range benefits from the firm's ergonomic and design knowledge, so it can learn from and improve the product.
This design is closely related to the established offer, which gives high absorptive capacity for assimilating market feedback.
A lever handle family strengthens system breadth in a domain the firm knows deeply, supported by its own R&D.
The electronic access system with unique light technology builds on the firm's existing access-control competence and matches its strategic move toward digital building organization.
